name: Circular Gallery
rationale: Clean-room implementation from the one-line effect description only; no React Bits source was read, and the ogl/WebGL dependency is replaced by per-item DOM transforms on a circular arc plus a CSS perspective bend, so it ships dependency-free.

bend.description: Tilt, in degrees, of an item at the host's edge; 0 is flat, negative curves upward.

speed.description: Auto-scroll speed in px per second; 0 disables the drift, negative reverses it.

ease.description: Smoothing factor per frame for drag, wheel and key moves.

draggable.description: Let the pointer drag the strip.

pauseOnHover.description: Pause the drift while the pointer or focus is inside.

a11y: Items stay real list items in DOM order with their own links and captions; nothing is cloned, so screen readers read each item once.
Keyboard users Tab through the item links; a focused item is brought to the centre, the drift pauses while focus is inside, and ArrowLeft/ArrowRight step one item.
Only horizontal wheel input (or Shift+wheel) moves the strip, so vertical page scrolling is never hijacked, and a real drag suppresses the trailing link click.
Reduced motion leaves a plain horizontal scroll-snap strip with no arc, drift, rAF loop or bend.
